notes.title: 🌊 Swim with us toward World Ocean Day Festival and help us save marine life! 🐳
notes.content:
[h3] The ocean is cruicial for our entire planet's ecosystems, producing more oxygen and absorbing more carbon than all the forests combined 💧 This event is all about protecting it and its many incredible inhabitants. [/h3]

World Ocean Day Festival is an event by Games For Waves, gaming and streaming community created by Whale and Dolphin Conservation. The goal? To connect gaming industry with real-world conservation efforts. The festival kicks off today and Untold Tales joins in with [b]EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition[/b] and many other titles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39873559/1100d557d97384564b6d41b5b928ce40cf02a4ba.png[/img]

🗓️ From June 5th to 12th, [b]we're pledging 20% of our net profits to Whale and Dolphin Conservation[/b] and you get to purchase our games, EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition included, at [i]deep[/i] discounts. This year, every purchase WDC to protect the ocean and the seas from deadly lost and discarded fishing gear! 🛶🎣🐟

[previewyoutube=7TmAZSZtikA;full][/previewyoutube]

 [h2][b]About EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition[/b][/h2]

[b]EcoGnomix Deluxe Edition[/b] is more than just a collector’s item – it’s a talisman of good fortune.

Why? Well, in the world of EcoGnomix, gnomes believe that the game’s enchanting Soundtrack carries melodies that bring luck and harmony. Pair that with spending creative time with the beautifully illustrated EcoGnomix Coloring Book, and you’ll be amplifying those positive powers even more.

Here’s what you’ll get in the EcoGnomix Deluxe Edition:

[*]The EcoGnomix base game
[*]A digital soundtrack
[*]A digital coloring book

💦 So, are you ready to dive in? Support marine life and celebrate the ocean with EcoGnomix - Deluxe Edition:

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/45622/EcoGnomix__Deluxe_Edition/

notes.title: EcoGnomix Patch 1.1: Balance Update is here! 🌿✨
notes.content:
We’re happy to bring you our first update, filled with the highly requested balance changes along with fixes to the reported issues. We won’t make the intro too long, so you can jump straight into the full patch notes below and see what’s new!

[u][b]NEW FEATURES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added unlockable "Upgrade Bans" that allow players to choose upgrades to exclude from Helena's shop
[/list]
[u][b]BALANCE[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Dry Canyon Boss now stays for 4 (up from 3) actions if it does not catch anything to devour
[*] Dry Canyon caves with a "food" map icon now have an increased number of oases
[*] Bug Rancher's bugs now yield 2 food when harvested (up from 1)
[*] Bug Rancher price increased to 10 (from 5)
[*] Reduced the number of bats spawned by Stringbloom (scorpion miniboss) from3 to 1
[*] Selling a gnome now refunds 50% of the costs of its upgrades in addition to the base gnome cost
[*] Scorpions can no longer attack flying gnomes with the "Flight Crew" upgrade
[*] Bat Nests can no longer spawn in completely inaccessible locations
[*] Increased the amount of "horns" dropped by bosses and minibosses
[*] Increased the Bombergnome's base damage to 4 (up from 3)
[*] Increased the damage on the Marksman's "Piercing" upgrade to 4 (up from 3)
[/list]
[u][b]BUGFIXES[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in Helena's shop if stealing from her
[*] Fixed a bug where Beaver Master, Alchemist, Bombergnome and Trapper would not work with the Socialite and Loner upgrades
[*] Fixed an issue where players would be sent back to the tutorial expedition if they quit the game during the first return to the city
[*] Stealing from Helena's shop is no longer possible during the tutorial
[*] Fixed "Delivery Service" description showing incorrect numbers
[*] Fixed an issue where statues could be built into the Warehouse in the city
[*] Fixed an issue where buildings would not get refunded if the build menu was opened while placing them
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to click a building hidden behind a UI button
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to click the "Next Cave" button while a turn was in progress
[*] Fixed an issue where the Trapper's traps would sometimes not react to newly spawned scorpions
[*] Fixed an issue where "Fire Weapon"and "Exterminator" would not trigger if the gnome with the upgrade did not perform the last hit
[*] Fixed an issue where changing resolution would not automatically change the UI scale
[*] Fixed an issue where the Craftsgnome's "Tilebreaker" upgrade could yield basic wood in biomes 2 and 3
[*] Fixed an issue where the game could get stuck if using the "Meat Shield" upgrade
[*] Various localization fixes (typos and missing translations)
[/list]
We can’t thank you enough for sharing your feedback and suggestions with us. We’re thrilled to shape the game based on your input, and we hope these new changes enhance your experience, letting you explore the caves in ways you’ve never imagined before (or maybe you did and suggested it :D)!

Yours, 
Untold Tales and Irox Games

notes.title: Community News: Balance update in the works! 🌿
notes.content:
Hey there, fellow gnome enthusiasts! 🧙‍♂️🌱

First off, a big [u][b]THANK YOU[/b][/u] for being here with us for the launch of EcoGnomix! We hope you’re having a gnome-tastic time going through the caves and working for Benjamin… 
Oops, did we say ‘for’? We meant to say ‘with’, of course, with Benjamin. 

Now, we know some of you may feel like the difficulty is a tad too high, especially after the first biome. We’ve heard your feedback, and our team is hard at work on a balancing update to make sure your experience stays challenging but not as much as it was. We’re trying our best to deliver the update as soon as possible, so keep your eyes open for future news this week!

Remember, this game was made for you, the players, and we want to make sure you’re having all of the expected fun. That’s why we’d love to hear your feedback, opinions and suggestions, as they truly help us improve EcoGnomix.  

And if you’re enjoying your time with us, don’t be shy – [b]leave us a review, a thumbs up, or a few kind words[/b]. Every bit helps our gnome-filled community grow! 🙏

Cheers, 
Untold Tales and Irox Games

notes.title: EcoGnomix Soundtrack + interview with a GNOME?!💿 🧙
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Explorers! 🎩🧐


The Official [b]EcoGnomix Soundtrack[/b] is arriving on [b]September 30th[/b], along with the [b]game’s full release![/b] [/h3]

We’ve asked one of our Gnomes, Gnorman, a couple of questions about the tunes, have a read: 

[quote]
[b]Interviewer:[/b] Welcome, Gnorman! It’s fantastic to have you here to chat about the EcoGnomix Soundtrack. How are you today?

[b]Gnorman:[/b] [i]*Weeee!*[/i] Hello! I’m doing gnometastic, thank you. I’ve been busy tending to mi garden and humming along to our new soundtrack. Heard mi neighbor was doing it too!

[b]Interviewer:[/b] Well, your neighbor seems to have great taste in music then! Anyway, can you tell us a bit about your favorite track from the soundtrack?

[b]Gnorman: [/b][i]*Hiihii*[/i]. Mi favorite track has to be [i][b]Hit It In The Cactobulos[/b][/i]! Mi little feet went [i]*tap, tap, tap* [/i]within the first seconds once I heard it for the first time. See? Even now when I’m just thinking about the song! [i]*tap, tap, tap* [/i]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] Oh my, you’re right! I get it though, it’s a great song! I’ve heard that each track has a unique story or purpose. What do you usually do while listening to [i][b]The Mystery That Caught My Eye[/b][/i]?

[b]Gnorman:[/b] [i]*Humh*[/i]. This one is a treat! We, gnomes, listen to it on our treasure hunting adventures. The track’s intriguing melody makes all of the treasures go [i][b]*bling*[/b][/i], so we can spot it easily! [i]*tehe*[/i]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] Wow, I need that kind of song in my life too, haha. Can you tell me who composed all of the [b]15 EcoGnomix songs[/b]? 

[b]Gnorman:[/b] [i]*Yippie*[/i] Rumor has it that a HUMAN named [b]Alec Shea[/b] composed the soundtrack, along with the help from [b]Jeff Saxon[/b] (Whistling) and [b]Mariya Anastasova[/b] (Vocals). But we, gnomes, don’t believe they’re human. Only gnomes could create such wonderful music and sounds. Have you ever heard a real human whistle THIS good? [i]*Phhh*[/i]

[b]Interviewer:[/b] Now that’s an interesting theory, hmm… Maybe I will have to do some research on it in the future. Well, looks like our time has run out, thanks so much for chatting, Gnorman! 

[b]Gnorman:[/b] [i]*Haww*[/i] That went fast! Thank you! We, gnomes, hope to see all of the Explorers tapping their feet along with ours to these wonderful tunes soon! Oh, here they go again [i]*tap, tap, tap*[/i]! Gotta run! [i]*whoosh*[/i]
[/quote]

And there you have it, Explorers – a gnome’s view of the EcoGnomix Soundtrack! 

We hope Gnorman’s toe-tapping enthusiasm has you excited for the game’s full launch and that the tunes will get your feet going too! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3216420/EcoGnomix_Original_Soundtrack/

See you around, 
Irox Games and Untold Tales

notes.title: EcoGnomix - The release date is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/afb4b8e8db84af3b55aab998f3eb95fd96a3be63.png[/img]

EcoGnomix is a quirky rogue-lite strategy and city-building game. Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes. Combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna.

Get ready to flex your strategic muscles and take on the challenge in this unique adventure, the future of our gnomes is in your hands!

[previewyoutube=a-dVs17XDFE;full][/previewyoutube]

Features:
- Small gnomes that chop trees and hunt chicken
- Upgrade banners that combine in unexpected ways
- Countless caves with a lot of explorable content
- A settlement with tiny gnomes and small production chains
- Roguelite-style progression with permanent unlockables
- The urge to explore just one more cave
- Great gamepad support for lazy couch sessions

notes.title: Announcement Trailer
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/d50b9739ff4bf823b6a1013378e41093f8c8efb2.png[/img]

EcoGnomix is a quirky roguelite strategy and city-building game. Build a covert business empire, by looting the underground world with a team of gnomes. Combine upgrades strategically to help your gnomes survive an unlimited supply of mystical caves with unique flora and fauna.
Get ready to flex your strategic muscles and take on the challenge in this unique adventure, the future of our gnomes is in your hands!

[previewyoutube=FiRP8IzkaIo;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Small gnomes that chop trees and hunt chicken
[*] Upgrade banners that combine in unexpected ways
[*] Countless caves with a lot of explorable content
[*] A settlement with tiny gnomes and small production chains
[*] Roguelite style progression with permanent unlockables
[*] The urge to explore just one more cave
[*] Great gamepad support for lazy couch sessions
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2473640/EcoGnomix/

notes.title: Unearth Excitement with EcoGnomix During Steam Farming Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44313274/3dd18c8a3545580690a550be051a31e8948fb95b.png[/img]

Calling all dungeon delvers and aspiring gnome overlords! ⛏️ EcoGnomix is thrilled to be part of the Steam Farming Fest! 
Head over to the EcoGnomix Steam Page now and download the demo during the Steam Farming Fest. Witness the quirky charm and strategic depth of EcoGnomix for yourself!

If you played our last demo - here's what's new!

[b]Biome 1[/b]
[list]
[*] New end boss
[*] Multiple end boss stages for subbiomes
[*] Changed how gnome target prioritization works
[*] Drag and drop interaction for gnome placement
[*] Fixed multiple issues with gnome upgrades
[/list]
[b]Rare caves[/b]
Players can now encounter rare caves that have different shapes and feature an abundance of resources. A secret hint on the map will show you where the strange caves may appear. Can you find it?
